title: The Mismeasure of Man and Models: Evaluating Allocational Harms in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper introduces and evaluates a new metric for measuring allocational bias in Large Language Models. While fairness and allocational harm are ethical considerations in AI deployment, the study specifically focuses on demographic bias metrics (like demographic parity and equal opportunity) rather than benchmarking religious beliefs, faith traditions, or systems of moral/ethical reasoning.
